title: Cobras Fall Short in 6–5 Shootout Battle vs. Fire Truck Club – Wild Back-and-Forth Game 12/7/25
description:
Fire Truck Club vs. Globo Gym King Cobras D — Game #4919
Final Score: Fire Truck Club 6 – Cobras 5
Date: 12/07/25 • League: BH Adult D
Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 2

This matchup delivered one of the most fast-paced, offense-heavy games of the season. Both teams traded goals across all three periods, with six first-period tallies setting the tone for a wild back-and-forth battle. Despite a persistent push and a big night from several Cobras skaters, Fire Truck Club held on for a narrow 6–5 win.

📝 Game Notes

One of the most offensively explosive games of the season.

Cobras scored three goals in the third period, nearly completing the comeback.

Matthew Killeen led the way with two goals and an assist.

Dettman, Chase, and Smith all added goals for the Cobras.

Fire Truck Club capitalized early, scoring four times in the first two periods.

Both teams combined for seven penalties, adding to the physical tone.
